chapters.title: Introduction to Shemuel Bet Chapter 2
chapters.about: The aftermath of Shaul's death and the struggle for the monarchy.

chapters.title: David seeks counsel from Hashem
chapters.about: Asking Hashem questions through the Urim V'Tummim one at a time.

chapters.title: David goes to Chevron and is anointed
chapters.about: David moves to Chevron with his wives and men, and is anointed king over Yehudah.

chapters.title: The recurring word alah
chapters.about: The text repeating the word alah five times to show David's rise.

chapters.title: Why Chevron?
chapters.about: Strategic reasons in the tribe of Yehudah and the connection to Me'arat HaMachpelah.

summary: Rabbi Tawil begins the second chapter of Shemuel Bet, focusing on the struggle for the monarchy after the death of Shaul. He explains how David seeks guidance from Hashem through the Urim V'Tummim and moves to Chevron to be anointed king over the House of Yehudah. He also discusses the strategic and religious significance of Chevron as well as the recurring word alah in these verses.
subjects: Anointing David over the House of Yehudah
questions: How did David ask Hashem for guidance after Shaul died?
Why did David choose Chevron to begin his reign over Yehudah?
What lesson does the text teach about David's previous mistakes with the Urim V'Tummim?
What is the significance of the word alah appearing five times in the opening verses?
